Message.Name: Time Reference Message
Message.Description: The Time Reference message is used to provide a midnight reference point for recipients of the feed.

Field.Name: Midnight Reference
Field.Description: Midnight Eastern Time reference time for subsequent Time messages, expressed as number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Field.Name: Time Reference
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Current Trade Date

Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is immediately generated and sent when there is a FLEX event for a given clock second.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day.

Field.Name: Epoch Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Message.Name: FLEX Instrument Definition Message
Message.Description: A FLEX Instrument Definition message represents an instrument that is available to place orders.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Root
Field.Description: OSI Root right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Year
Field.Description: Two digit year

Field.Name: Month
Field.Description: Two digit month

Field.Name: Day
Field.Description: Two digit day

Field.Name: Call Put Indicator
Field.Description: Call/Put indicator

Field.Name: Dollar Strike
Field.Description: Dollar strike (if not percentage) left padded with zero. If percentage, field is space padded.

Field.Name: Decimal Strike
Field.Description: Decimal strike (if not percentage) left padded with zero. If percentage, field is space padded.

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: Symbol condition indicator

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Instrument Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Exercise Style
Field.Description: Exercise style indicator

Field.Name: Settlement Type
Field.Description: Settlement type indicator

Field.Name: Percentage
Field.Description: Percentage when strike and price is percentage based (implied 4 decimal places). Otherwise zero.

Field.Name: Observation Day
Field.Description: Two digit observation day of month. Valid only for Asian and Cliquet options, otherwise space padded.

Field.Name: Return Cap Percentage
Field.Description: Return cap percentage (implied 2 decimal places). Valid only for Cliquet, otherwise zero.

Field.Name: Creation Day
Field.Description: Two digit creation day of the month. Valid only for Cliquet, otherwise space padded.

Field.Name: Bit Fields
Field.Description: Bit 0: If set, strike/price in percentage. Bit 1-7: Reserved

Message.Name: Complex FLEX Instrument Definition Message
Message.Description: A Complex FLEX Instrument Definition message represents a complex instrument that is available to place orders.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument ID
Field.Description: Complex Instrument ID right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Type
Field.Description: 4 character field. Character 1: Complex Option Type. Characters 2-4: Reserved.

Field.Name: Leg Count
Field.Description: The number of legs in the complex instrument. The maximum number of legs is 100.

Field.Name: Message Count
Field.Description: Number of messages required to define the complex instrument.

Field.Name: Message Number
Field.Description: Message number of the message count, e.g. 1 of 5.

Field.Name: Message Leg Count
Field.Description: The number of legs in this message.

Field.Name: Complex FLEX Leg
Field.Description: Repeating leg group

Message.Name: Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: Auction Notification messages are used to disseminate order details of a FLEX Auction.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: FLEX Instrument ID
Field.Description: FLEX Instrument ID right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction type indicator

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side indicator

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price. Price will be zero for Auction Type = B and F. Price will be included for Auction Type = S.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: Customer indicator

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Executing Broker (optional) of firm attributed to this auction.

Field.Name: Auction End Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last timestamp.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: User defined identifier for quote attribution.

Message.Name: DAC Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: DAC Auction Notification messages are used to disseminate order details of a DAC FLEX Auction.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: FLEX Instrument ID
Field.Description: FLEX Instrument ID right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction type indicator

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side indicator

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: Customer indicator

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Executing Broker (optional) of firm attributed to this auction.

Field.Name: Auction End Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last timestamp.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: User defined identifier for quote attribution.

Field.Name: DAC Reference Price
Field.Description: Value used as the initial reference price for a delta adjust at close auction.

Field.Name: DAC Delta Count
Field.Description: Number of delta values for this auction.

Field.Name: DAC Delta
Field.Description: Repeating delta value group

Message.Name: Auction Cancel Message
Message.Description: Auction Cancel messages are used to disseminate the cancellation of an earlier Auction Notification message.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction

Message.Name: Auction Trade Message
Message.Description: Auction Trade messages are used to disseminate executions resulting from an auction.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this execution

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price. If instrument trades in percentage terms, then this represents the traded percentage with four implied decimals.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded

Message.Name: Trade Long Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of FLEX orders on the Cboe Options trading floor.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Order ID of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always "B"

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded

Field.Name: FLEX Instrument ID
Field.Description: FLEX Instrument ID right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price. If instrument trades in percentage terms, then this represents the traded percentage with four implied decimals.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Trade Condition code

Message.Name: Trade Short Message
Message.Description: The Trade (short) message provides information about executions of FLEX orders on the Cboe Options trading floor.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Order ID of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always "B"

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded

Field.Name: FLEX Instrument ID
Field.Description: FLEX Instrument ID right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price. If instrument trades in percentage terms, then this represents the traded percentage with two implied decimals.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Trade Condition code

Message.Name: DAC Trade Message
Message.Description: The DAC Trade message provides information about executions of Delta Adjusted at Close (DAC) FLEX orders on the Cboe Options trading floor.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Order ID of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always "B"

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded

Field.Name: FLEX Instrument ID
Field.Description: FLEX Instrument ID right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Trade Condition code

Field.Name: DAC Reference Price
Field.Description: Reference price of the DAC trade.

Field.Name: DAC Closing Price
Field.Description: Price used as the closing price for DAC trade repricing. $0 unless repricing a DAC trade after the close.

Field.Name: DAC Delta Value
Field.Description: The delta value applied to this DAC trade (within the range -1.0000 through 1.0000; 0 if a complex instrument).

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Trade Break message is sent whenever a FLEX options execution on Cboe is broken.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Cboe execution identifier of the execution that was broken.

Message.Name: Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: A Symbol Mapping message is used to map the 6 character multicast feed symbol field to an OSI symbol and Underlying.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: Symbol condition indicator

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying equity right padded with spaces. All spaces if not available or not applicable.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of a FLEX options instrument.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Trading status indicator

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: GTH Trading Status
Field.Description: GTH Trading Status indicator

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for each unit when the unit shuts down.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Group.Name: Complex FLEX Leg
Group.Description: Repeating leg definition for complex FLEX instruments. Repeats Message Leg Count times.

Field.Name: Leg Symbol
Field.Description: FLEX Symbol, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg ratio (positive for buy-side, negative for sell-side).

Field.Name: Leg Security Type
Field.Description: The instrument type of this leg.

Group.Name: DAC Delta
Group.Description: Repeating delta value for DAC auctions. Repeats DAC Delta Count times.

Field.Name: Delta Value
Field.Description: Delta value, from -1.0000 to 1.0000 (four implied decimal places).
